name: case-alerts
description: Case management alerts in a record's history (2026-11-16). An alert that fires writes an 'alert' event to the case's history, once even with several subscriber servers, and the console History tab shows it with a bell and an Alerts switch; before, the event was written but the console dropped it. The alert has no notifications, so nothing is sent. Each run adds an open case, which the alert fires on after 1 minute, and a closed case, which it must not, to the test's own survey; both are kept.
